notes.title: eSail optional Version 3 Beta
notes.notes:
eSail V3 BETA (3.0.x) is an exciting new update that brings new features to the eSail community.  As always, our updates are free for all eSail users. V3 is based on Unity 6 which itself is in Beta.  As well as adding new features, a lot of work has been done on compatibility with Unity 6. Although this doesn't add anything for users short term, it means we are on the right platform going forward, which should speed up development.

NOTE 1: Before running the Beta backup your data folder. See the Technical Support discussion for this folder's location.
NOTE 2: Challenges are excluded from the beta. This is because the boat handling has changed slightly. We will probably have new leaderboards once V3 is fully released.
NOTE 3:  All new text is in English only. Translations will be added once the Beta is completed.  At that stage will will also add speech in languages as required.
NOTE 4:  Users on the beta will be in a different 'world' to those on V2.

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Better graphics.  All terrain textures have been improved. There is also now more use of the 'Detailed World' setting which adds more objects including rocks, trees, roads and harbour details. Even the seaweed has been replaced with something a bit more appealing (although remember performance considerations do limit the detail!)  Many buildings have been given window lights. This can help when night sailing.
[*] Wind variability (Live Sailing).  Now the wind responds to the shape of nearby land causing wind shifts. Anabatic and katabatic breezes cause patches on the water surface which the observant sailor can use to maximise speed!  For more information see [url=Wind in eSail]https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/the-world-of-esail/wind/[/url]
[*] New 'Trade Islands' added.  These islands are slightly tidal so you have to be aware of tidal heights. There are published tide tables for the islands. 
[*] New chart for the Trade Islands.  This is available once you have collected all the POIs for Navaronne etc. This level is now classified as 'Atlantic Explorer'.  The new level for the Trade Islands is 'Tidal Explorer'.
[*] Reference section and notebook.  On the menu there is a new button for 'Reference'.  Here you can look up any term or function featured in eSail.  There is also a simple notebook for making - you guessed it - notes.
[*] Boat detailing.  We have started an ongoing process of adding more graphical detail to the boat. This includes a new masthead wind indicator.
[*] Reciprocal button on the chart plotter. This enables you to quickly read a line from the opposite bearing.
[*] The depth sounder now reads depth taking into account wave and tide height.
[*] Hands and wheel centre adjustable brightness.
[*] Each chart now is saved with zoom and position.
[*] Added an ‘all lines delete’ button to charts.
[*] Run in Background option. See the first section of Settings.
[*] Added Settings to modify keyboard steering and throttle.
[*] Plan view - you can now plot the courses of boats, with boat names now visible on the plan. So before racing this can be turned on. In the event of possible foul play, take a screenshot so that we can see how the action has unfolded.  Click on the chart plotter behind the compass, then the orange button.
[*] Glance view added to Smart Button. Drag left or right on the button so see at 90 degrees. See the tooltip for keyboard shortcuts.
[/list]

[b]eSail Pro[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where autopilot was always setting to apparent wind (in Wind Mode).
[*] Tidal Curve tool. This interactive tool can be found in the chart drawer.
[*] Tidal heights tutorials.
[*] Added tack mode to autopilot. While using the autopilot hit the button to steer the boat onto the opposite tack.
[/list]

Thank you for your suggestions which have been incorporated here.  Please add feedback to the new V3 discussion.  All feedback is very welcome!


To swap to the V3 Beta:

First back up your data!

1. Right click on eSail in your Steam client.

2. On the drop down menu click 'Properties'

3. Click on the BETAS tab.

4. Select 'eSail_V3' branch.  The password is:  eSailEmerald

notes.title: eSail 2.4.10f2
notes.notes:
This update provides an agreement checkbox, so that the user needs to accept that eSail is not a replacement for professional training by a qualified instructor. In addition we point out limitations - we cannot simulate the physical and mental demands of real world sailing. Also we highlight that no simulator can always replicate real world physics, especially as all boats behave differently.  The agreement only needs to be accepted once by each user/boat.  

This wording is in preparation for eSail V3.  We will be adding tidal height information so it is really important that users realize the limitations of eSail. We do not want users grounding their real life boats!  But the wording applies to V2 as well and builds on the current licence agreement and warnings we have placed across all marketing materials.

We have also changed some wording in Settings.  We now have a 'Detailed world' checkbox.  The text states that this provides more detailed sky and terrain. Actually the increased terrain details in V2 are barely noticeable.  But in V3 we will have some nice eye candy, and this option will become more important so users can conserve resources if their machine is struggling with the new detail.

notes.title: New eSail Update 2.4.08
notes.notes:
This new update is designed to help novice sailors, as well as fix a few bugs.

1. Added a Points of Sail diagram.  This can be accessed from the 'Adjusting the Mainsail' tutorial.  (In V3 all learning resources will be accessible from a central location.)

2. Previously it was easy to accidentally click on the sail bag in the cabin and deploy the asymmetric without even knowing it. So we have now added a confirmation alert.

3. We have added a note in first tutorial about how the tutorials are saved and how to access other tutorials / challenges.

4. We have modified the starting boat positions of the basic tutorials to help novice sailors avoid crashing into the training buoys or land.

5. Fixed bug - when changing line (radial left) hands hotspot was disappearing.

6. Fixed bug - where medals would appear on changing the time between local/UTC on the Multiplayer Challenges screen.

7. Fixed bug - page 3737 wave file (English only) as this referred to travellers not being in eSail which is no longer the case.

8. Changed visibility of boat name on stern so that it can be seen at a greater distance. 

9. Improvement to multiplayer to avoid to avoid boats appearing on top of one another.

10. German language fixes. Thank you to Tjabo for pointing these out!

11. Improvements in mooring to reduce errors with disappearing/misaligned mooring lines. Thank you Peter for all your testing of these issues.

12. Fixed bug where dragging on screen to look around or orbit could lock up.

To force an update, sign out of Steam (user your user top right), then sign back in again.  Otherwise Steam will automatically update your eSail in due course.

notes.title: v2.4 with Face Input!
notes.notes:
eSail v2.4 has a new experimental face input feature as well as a number of small fixes.

[list]
[*] Rev counter now fixed (eSail Pro).  The dial could get stuck on 1000 revs when opening and closing the panel. 
[*] Changed water reflections to reduce reflection when foggy.
[*] Reduced error logging when screen dragging to avoid filling log files with unnecessary messages.
[*] Now automatically moves anchor back on boat when it becomes detached.
[*] Face input to look around inside eSail (Pro DLC only).  See instructions below.
[/list]

Thank you for users for pointing out these issues!

[u]Face Input[/u]
[b]NOTE: This is an eSail Pro feature[/b]
This exciting new feature is currently only tested on Windows. It enables you to look around inside eSail by moving your head.  It is best used with a good screen size. A phone or other mobile device is used to capture your head angle.  This input is sent to a separate 'eSail Face Input' app on your computer, which in turn sends the input to eSail.  If after testing we find the feature is useful to the community, we will hopefully incorporate the capture functionality into future eSail releases so you will not need the eSail Face Input app.  

Requirements:
[list]
[*] iPhone/iPad meeting these [url=https://support.apple.com/en-us/102854]requirements.[/url]
[*] Windows computer
[*] eSail and eSail Pro add-on/DLC
[/list]

To set up Face Input:
1)  Download the [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1z3MCrzJz4B3VnnmHdC9HStB1_so-ztP3]eSail Face Input[/url] app onto your computer. 
2) Extract the zip file and put it somewhere convenient.  You will probably want to make a shortcut on your desktop to the executable file eSailFaceInput.exe 
3) On your mobile device (currently only tested with Apple IOS) go to App store and download Unity Face Capture 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207645/900d1aa7b8df19190211204c02bfc33315296335.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32207645/8b82a8d421321dc711ea1b553e75b6f76cabd82a.png[/img][/url]

Using Face Input:
1)  First start eSail.  Go into Live Sailing or any other module.  Open Settings and scroll to the bottom.  Check the box to enable Face Input.   Save settings.
2) Now you can toggle Face Input on and off using the 'End' key.  This is hard coded so make sure it does not conflict with other keys you may have set up.
3) When Face input is running you will notice that you cannot drag on the screen to look around.  However, you can still orbit.
4) Start the eSail Face Input app.  NOTE: First time you will probably get a Windows Defender warning.  Click on More and Run Anyway (the exact messages may vary).  
Make sure you can easily change between the apps.  I find Alt+Tab an easy way in Windows.
5) Start your Unity Face Capture on your mobile.  You need to allow access to the camera and the network. No other permissions are needed.
6) Ignore various warnings about needing Unity Editor - you don't!
7) Once the face capture is working you should be able to move the head inside the eSail Face Input app.
8) If communication is working between eSail Face Input and eSail you will see the screen moving as you move your head.

Tips:
[list]
[*] Use the settings to adjust speed of movement.  
[*] The default deadzone settings assume you have placed your phone centrally under your screen.  If you put your phone somewhere else you will need to adjust.  If you put your mobile above the screen you will need to change the X deadzone settings.
[*] Make sure you do not have a light behind your head, and make sure you have reasonable lighting on your face.
[*] Glasses may cause issues if you have a lot of reflection on them!
[*] When changing between modules, such as between Live Sailing and a tutorial, eSail effectively restarts.  Because of this you will need to click the restart button in eSail Face Capture AFTER the new eSail module has fully loaded.
[/list]

Likely issues:
There are two layers of communication - between mobile and computer and between the two eSail apps on your computer.  Either could be blocked by firewalls.  Please let us know of any issues and we will attempt to resolve them and will certainly learn a lot!

notes.title: New eSail Pro DLC
notes.notes:
eSail Pro is the latest add-on for eSail Sailing Simulator. eSail Pro takes the simulator to the next level with advanced instruments, a refillable fuel tank and more.

The new instruments include a fuel gauge which also shows engine hours. The tank size is 15 gallons and can be filled at Port Fogerty on the South of the main Shearwater Island.

There is also an new wind indicator, showing true and apparent wind speed/direction. Below this we have a new autopilot instrument, providing incremental controls and the ability to set the autopilot to the wind. This is very useful when racing, but is a convenience in general sailing too.

eSail Pro enables you to try more advanced sailing such as mooring under sail. And we have also added a Mooring Sandbox where you can set wind speed and direction to practise your mooring. This is supported by two new tutorials covering more advanced mooring techniques and how to get the best out of eSail Pro.

notes.title: New eSail Update 2.3.05
notes.notes:
This new version brings you:

1. A fix to stop out of range data causing issues for all users in multiplayer mode.

2. A new steam ship (The Aurora) is running between Water Head Islands and Port Fogarty in Southern Shearwater Island. As this is a lot of water to cover when testing any sightings (or even better screenshots) would be much appreciated.

3. An ensign flag is now on the backstay. This helps to give an indication of wind direction. You can change the size and position of flag in Settings. (Or turn it off by making size zero).

4. You can now change the sleeve colours of both crew members in Settings.

5. On the chart you can now add extra lines. Also you can set the angle of the plotter (bottom left). This means at last you can properly plot your position using the hand compass.

This new update fixes a number of small issues:

1) When jumping to race start in eSail multiplyaer racing, sometimes you could end up on the rocks at the end of the race start line. eSail now jumps you close to the middle of the start line.

notes.title: NEW eSail Sailing Simulator V2 released!
notes.notes:
eSail V2 represents over a year's development work and introduces a whole new virtual sailing experience.  Here is a full list of major new features:

Multiplayer. Now users can interact with each other in multiplayer Live Sailing. As before you are subject to the ever changing Shearwater weather, but now you can 'VHF' chat to other eSailors and take part in races against other boats.  VHF chat is similar to real VHF in that it is possible to talk over other radio users, so you need to follow some protocols (which are explained in the simulator).    

New languages added by our amazing community translators - Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, Greek, Italian, Dutch (existing languages are English, French, Russian and German). All languages are subject to constant update and improvement, so please contact us if have feedback or can add anything.

Live Sailing Courses.  Here you can create your own courses including race courses and passages. Once you have a course you can set up private races by simply sending friends or other boats an access code.  

Multiplayer races.  Join in with regular eSail multiplayer races. These will be added depending on demand so just let us know the best times and we will do our best to create challenges for you!  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HBiIxNUtQd0


eSail Server.  You can now get information about the status of the Shearwater world including the weather/forecast and the location of other boats, race results etc. by going straight to our server web page: https://esail-server-ui.herokuapp.com/

Asymmetric spinnaker. This sail is great for everything from a beam reach to running downwind. The 'asy' is deployed in a snuffer, and when released tends to lift the bow giving higher boat speeds (in the right wind). Using the asymmetric you can exceed hull speed and plane. See the Advanced Tutorial for details on how to deploy and handle the sail.

Sandbox. This is a fantastic way of getting the best from your eSail boat. You can set wind direction & strength and wave height, then adjust your sails to match. If you note down the best trim this can give a real advantage when racing!

[b]New Settings options:[/b]

Detailed sky giving more realistic atmospheric effects such as 'god rays'.

Prop walk so you can set how the propeller affects how the stern is kicked sideways in reverse. This is really useful when practising mooring. 

Physics priority. This helps tune eSail to match the capabilities of your machine.

Multiplayer mode, including the option to set time to +12 hours (so you don't have to sail in the dark!)

New music and option to turn music off.

[b]Other enhancements include:[/b]

Better boat detailing, including new textures on the sail bag and hull. 

Deck and cabin lights making night sailing easier.

Better modelling of heel, so it is actually possible to broach or capsize under extreme conditions.

F11 to toggle user interface on and off.

eSail version 2 has been extensively Beta tested, but it is just the start of the V2 development roadmap, so please report any issues experienced.  We will fix these as quickly as possible in future updates as well as adding more exciting new features!

notes.title: New ‘Man Overboard’ DLC Launched
notes.notes:
eSail has today launched a new ‘Man Overboard’ (MOB) add-on for eSail Sailing Simulator. The add-on – or downloadable content (DLC) – has been developed with the help of marine safety expert Keith Colwell, author of the RYA Sea Survival Handbook. It includes tutorials, challenges and random triggering of MOB during normal sailing. The drill includes heaving-to, deploying equipment and recovery of the MOB under power and sail.

‘Man Overboard’ features 2 tutorials, 2 challenges and a random MOB mode while ‘Live Sailing’ so you can test your readiness when the unexpected happens.

Man Overboard was created in close collaboration with Keith Colwell. Keith has worked for many years as a reporter and editor for sailing journals. He has also worked for the RNLI for 15 years and during that time trained and managed RNLI Sea Safety and Community Safety volunteers to give advice to yachtsmen, boat users and the general public on how to stay safe when on or by the water. He became a RYA sea survival, powerboat and marine vhf radio instructor/assessor in 2004, while working for the RNLI, and currently works as a freelance instructor.

notes.title: Update 1.5.31 - Anchoring
notes.notes:
This version has been released to fix or improve anchoring issues in eSail.

These issues should now have been fixed:

1) The anchor was tending to slide along the sea bed (except when the chain was hidden).

2) When the chain was hidden it tended to break on retraction. This should be improved but that doesn't mean its impossible to break the simulation!

3) Live Sailing saving of anchor / chain sometimes caused the anchor/chain to vanish.

4) If you motored with the anchor compartment open, the anchor could fly off. Now the top chain links and anchor are locked when not being extended/retracted. (We have also added some notes to the anchoring tutorial about being careful about speed and steering to avoid breaking the simulation - as in real life you would want to avoid breaking the windless!)

5) Weird anchor behaviour - floating/ not digging in etc.

6) Anchor sliding down hill - see above. It should now lock to a slope when not being pulled or when chain is extending. It will still slide when being pulled.

7) When swapping between users (from inside eSail) sometimes Live Sailing got confused and saved the wrong location.

8) Some physics changes have been to improve chain stability.

Thank you for all our testers and beta testers for your feedback.

notes.title: Optional Beta 1.5.28 - Anchoring
notes.notes:
This new Beta version has been released to fix or improve anchoring issues in eSail.
You can also help improve performance by testing different settings.  See below on how to help and how to swap to the beta.

These issues should now have been fixed:

1) The anchor was tending to slide along the sea bed (except when hidden).

2) When the chain was hidden it tended to break on retraction. This should be improved but that doesn't mean its impossible to break the simulation!

3) Live Sailing saving of anchor / chain sometimes caused the anchor/chain to vanish.

4) If you motored with the anchor compartment open, the anchor could fly off. Now the top chain links and anchor are locked when not being extended/retracted.  (We have also added some notes to the anchoring tutorial about being careful about speed and steering to avoid breaking the simulation - as in real life you would want to avoid breaking the windless!)

5) Weird anchor behaviour - floating/ not digging in etc. 

6) Anchor sliding down hill - see above. It should now lock to a slope when not being pulled or when chain is extending. It will still slide when being pulled.

7) When swapping between users (from inside eSail) sometimes the Live Sailing got confused and saved the wrong location.


[u]Help testing anchoring settings[/u]

You can now gain access to 2 development control panels. By submitting any observations on the best settings you can really help us improve the performance. Please submit to the Betas forum.

Main (Ctrl+Alt+M) . Fixed time step is how often physics calculations are done. Smaller numbers are better but have more processing cost.

Anchoring (Ctrl+Alt+A).
You can change the chain link solver.  The default is 7 but larger numbers may help, giving greater accuracy but at higher CPU cost.

Collider len is how long each chain link collider is. The chain link is 1 unit long so I doubt if going longer than that would help but you never know!

NOTE: You will notice that changing 'detailed water effects' and the quality settings changes FPS a lot. If you are down near 30fps then you could be running out of CPU to do the physics calculations.

All feedback would be very useful. Please let me know whether you are hiding the chain and any other details you can if you submit some settings.


[u]To install the Beta version:[/u]

1. Right click on eSail in your Steam client.

2.  On the drop down menu click 'Properties'

3. Click on the BETAS tab.

4. Select the beta from the drop down list.

notes.title: NEW Version 1.5 with added sailing areas (and a volcano!)
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a new version of eSail with some great new features. NOTE: This new version requires DirectX 11.  

[u]New Sailing Areas.[/u] Now Master Explorers have access to newly charted islands to the North of Shearwater. The islands include 'Navarone' which is dominated by a huge active volcano - Mt. Mallory. To become a Master Explorer you need to collect all 13 level 1 POIs (Points of Interest).

[u]NEW POIs.[/u] There are 9 new 'Points of Interest' for you to find including the beautiful double Golden Angel Falls and a Seismic Monitoring Station.

[u]New Chart B2 - Shearwater to Navarone. [/u]This is a new small scale chart from the Shearwater Coast Guard covering the whole North Shearwater area. We may also add larger scale charts depending on user feedback. You can find the chart in a new drawer under the chart table (available to Master Explorers only).

There are also numerous small fixes and changes which will be documented on the eSail website support page. One worth noting is that we have changed the default zoom direction (mouse scroll). You can change this in Settings.

Once you start using the new version you will be able to see your POI ranking here: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/794860/leaderboards/3639942

If you have any problems running the new version please contact us via https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/support/ or the Technical Support forum.

Thank you to all our testers and beta testers for your extremely valuable feedback!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
eSail has now been updated to Version 1.4.2.  This update has a minor fix to prevent reefing lines becoming jammed. 

Meanwhile work on opening up new sailing areas to the North of Shearwater Island is progressing well and we should start testing next week. Internal testing and Beta testing will take several weeks and of course Beta testers will be the first to get the new POIs!

notes.title: New Beta 1.4.2 - minor update (Reefing)
notes.notes:
This new update has been created to improve reefing performance. In the current release it can be difficult to get the mainsail tight when it is being held down by the reefing lines, which can cause problems with the Reefing tutorial in particular.

I would very much appreciate feedback - please report any issues or confirm the improvement (hopefully!)   

Thank you to steveelliott4646 for reporting the issue.

P.S. If you have a moment please visit this video by Gregory Ball - a fellow eSailor who has created this beautiful atmospheric music and video of  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9OujDOPlAFghttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9OujDOPlAFg]Dawn at Shearwater Bay[/url]

notes.title: eSail Full Release
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that today we have taken eSail out of Early Access and published it as a full release.  I would like to thank everyone who has contributed with their feedback and ideas to get us to this point.

So what now?  Well the good news is the development does not stop here. We have lots more planned with a new sailing area coming next. That will be followed by some exciting new sailing features coming in the second half of the year.

We look forward to the next chapter in the eSail story!

notes.title: New eSail Sailing Simulator Update 1.4.x
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version with several new features. If you do not get the update then please log out of your Steam client, then back in.

1) Better ropes (sailing control lines). Available on the highest quality level. We also have kept the older lines for lower quality levels. Getting both working smoothly has been quite fiddly!

2) Improved boat detailing - mainly pulleys and nav lights. Again this is on the highest quality.

3) Added 'Detailed water' (Settings) this gives you a bow wave and water with more detail and less tiling.

4) Added new 'Boat views' showing the boat from 4 directions. There is a little diamond button near the SmartView button so you can quickly toggle between them. 

5) Added keyboard controls for views including new BoatViews.

6) Zoom speed setting. This changes speed when using keyboard and mouse scroll.

7) Volume settings for collisions, narration etc.

8) Numerous bug fixes, especially improved AutoSail to make it more consistent.

notes.title: New eSail Update 1.3.45!
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version with several new features. Please do try out this version (available on the beta branch) and let us have your feedback in the Beta forum. 

1) Better ropes (sailing control lines). Available on the highest quality level. We also have kept the older lines for lower quality levels.  Getting both working smoothly has been quite fiddly!

2) Improved boat detailing - mainly pulleys and nav lights. Again this is on the highest quality.

3) Added 'Detailed water' (Settings) this gives you a bow wave and water with more detail and less tiling.

4) Added new 'Boat views' showing the boat from 4 directions.  There is a little diamond button near the SmartView button so you can quickly toggle between them. 

5) Added keyboard controls for views including new BoatViews.

6) Zoom speed setting. This changes speed when using keyboard and mouse scroll.

7) Volume settings for collisions, narration etc.

8) Numerous bug fixes, especially tried to improve AutoSail and make it more consistent.

To get the Beta:

1) In your Steam client, right click on eSail Sailing Simulator (in the list on the left). Or control click in Mac.

2) A list of options should appear. Click on 'Properties' at the bottom of the list.

3) Click on the 'BETAS' tab and select 'beta -'  from the dropdown list.

4) That will download the Windows or Mac Beta as appropriate.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3_b
notes.notes: This update has now been made live.  It features a performance update which will help some Windows users and a new 'Add User' screen.

notes.title: New beta - update 1.3.3_b
notes.notes:
This new Windows only update has improved graphics performance (for some machines) and a slight modification to the 'add user' screen. To try the Beta:

1) In your Steam client, right click on eSail Sailing Simulator (in the list on the left). Or control click in Mac.

2) A list of options should appear. Click on 'Properties' at the bottom of the list.

3) Click on the 'BETAS' tab and select 'beta -'  from the dropdown list.

4) That will download the Windows Beta as appropriate. Mac version is unchanged.

Please report any issues or thoughts in 'eSail Beta' discussion group.

notes.title: New version of eSail for Windows and Mac
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version of eSail [i]Sailing Simulator[/i] with new trim controls and 2 new tutorials.  There is also a new race - the East Shearwater Drag Race.

A full list of changes can be found here: 
[url=https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/support] https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/support	[/url]


eSail v1.3 includes a voice over for the Sail Depth and Sail Trim tutorials by the fantastic Hannah White who in 2015 became the Guinness World Records holder for the fastest crossing of the English Channel in a single-handed dinghy by doing so in 3 hours, 44 minutes and 39 seconds. 

NOTE:  Thank you to all Beta testers. The Beta challenge have been removed from leaderboards but are still saved on your local machines.

The Mac version is performing well. We have noticed that the mouse scroll is rather fast. In the next update we will give more options to customise all your controls, so this will be improved then.

notes.title: NEW eSail BETA for Windows and Mac
notes.notes:
You can now try out and contribute to the latest update of eSail with this new Beta (1.2.2031)!  

This version has new trim controls - travellers, outhaul and backstay as well as many other enhancements and bug fixes.  There are also 2 new tutorials on Sail Depth and Sail Twist.

The boat handling has also changed a little - for instance we now factor in hull displacement better, so as your speed increases drag increases exponentially. This gives top speeds of around 8 knots which is realistic for this type of boat.  For that reason new (sailing) challenge results will go into new leaderboards.  Don't worry - your old results will still be available to view! NOTE:  The new leaderboards may be cleared when the update goes on general release.

Now you can run eSail on Mac too.  As with Windows, controller support is limited (although is being developed rapidly right now for the following update).

You feedback will be really important - especially on the sailing races - making sure we have the boat at the right level against the competition.  Please put any comments (positive and negative!) into the new BETA discussion forum. 

NOTE 1: splash screen resolution dialog is for testing only - please ignore.
NOTE 2: voice over will be added to new tutorials before full release.
NOTE 3: you can easily change back to the current version if you want to (until full release).

[H1]To install the BETA: [/H1]
1) In your Steam client, right click on eSail Sailing Simulator (in the list on the left). On Mac CTRL click.

2) Click on 'Properties'.

3) Click on the 'BETAS' tab and select 'beta -'  from the dropdown list.

4) If you don't see the beta in the list, log out of Steam then back in - this should refresh the list.

notes.title: eSail Sailing Simulator Version 1.2.1 Released
notes.notes:
This new version includes over 30 enhancements and bug fixes including:

* Feedback now links straight to Steam forums.

* IMPORTANT: We have changed how Settings/Day length works. Now the user’s day length is only used in Live Sailing and Locations. This to avoid time being manipulated in to get better scores in challenges.

* Added coordinate display to pencil in Chart. (Switched on bottom right). This is because it can be difficult to read the scale even for the experienced navigator. 

* Settings screen now accessible from first page.

* Improved quality (less flickering) as you move away from centre of the world.

* Now the Autosail panel rolls up with tablet.

* Stopped camera knock back after menu screens. 

* Fixed fender problem when fenders stack up in middle of boat.

* Change Sailing character behaviour so both can work at once.

For a full list go the the Support page at https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com

Thank you to all the community helpers for your feedback on the Betas.

notes.title: Update 1.2.08
notes.notes:
A minor update has been released today:

1)  Minor bug fixes relating to controller input.

2)  Adds keyboard support for Undo and Cross Crew.

3)  You can now turn off controller input so that you can map your controller to keys using your own software.

Next release:

A more comprehensive update is now in testing. This will help with the flicker problem you may get when you move to outlying islands. Also, hopefully it will finally solve the fenders getting stuck issue. We are just getting to grips with jib farleads too, so I expect these will included (TBC).

notes.title: 10 Gold Medals Achieved!
notes.notes:
We now have the first eSailor to have achieved 10 GOLD medals!

Eligable challenges include races such as the Bear Island Race, Treasure Hunts, Steering challenges and anchoring. There are also sailing passages such as 'Maxwell Marina to Frazer Town' where you need to navigate between waypoints, while keeping your sails in trim then moor up without hitting the jetty. 

Currently only 0.6% of eSailors have attained this achievement, compared to over 50% who have obtained Rookie Skipper status.

notes.title: Update 1.2.07
notes.notes: This new update improves controller support and has a number of minor bug fixes. In addition you can now reset your boat so that sails are down, mooring lines and fenders are stowed etc. (see Menu/Settings).

By the way, we have had our first Master Explorer (all 13 points of interest found)!
